chart.name: Errors/min by AZ
chart.programText: A = data('HTTPCode_*', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'HTTPCode_Backend_2XX')) and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['AvailabilityZone']).scale(60).publish(label='A')

chart.description: Over last minute (no data means zero)
chart.name: Spillover & max surgequeue
chart.programText:
A = data('SurgeQueueLength', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB') and filter('stat', 'upper') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).max().publish(label='A')
B = data('SpilloverCount', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum().scale(60).publish(label='B')

chart.name: Avg response latency (ms) by AZ
chart.programText:

B = (A*1000).publish(label='B')

chart.name: Top frontend errors/min
chart.programText: A = data('HTTPCode_ELB_*', filter=filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['sf_metric', 'LoadBalancerName', 'AvailabilityZone']).scale(60).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Highest backend error %
chart.programText:
A = data('HTTPCode_Backend_*', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['LoadBalancerName', 'AvailabilityZone']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('HTTPCode_Backend_2XX', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['LoadBalancerName', 'AvailabilityZone']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('HTTPCode_Backend_3XX', filter=filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['LoadBalancerName', 'AvailabilityZone']).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (1-(B+C)/A).scale(100).publish(label='D')

chart.name: # LBs
chart.programText: A = data('RequestCount', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB') and filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('AvailabilityZone', '*'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['LoadBalancerName', 'AWSUniqueId', 'AvailabilityZone']).count().publish(label='A')

chart.programText:
A = data('RequestCount', filter=filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('stat', 'sum') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), rollup='rate', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).scale(60).mean(over='1h').sum(by=['LoadBalancerName', 'AvailabilityZone']).publish(label='A', enable=False)

chart.name: Latency over last minute
chart.programText:
A = data('Latency', filter=filter('AvailabilityZone', '*') and filter('LoadBalancerName', '*') and filter('stat', 'mean') and filter('namespace', 'AWS/ELB'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['LoadBalancerName', 'AvailabilityZone']).publish(label='A', enable=False)

E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')
